notes: Recorded 18 master's rows (1 Duke, 7 UNC departments, 1 ICU, 7 Bradford, 1 Queensland, 1 Uppsala) and 1 certificate row. Bradford, ICU, Queensland, Uppsala and Duke each state their programmes in full on the pages read; the UNC side is an open-ended list of departments ('e.g.'), so more UNC departments may be possible.

Rotary's own pages (master's degree programmes and certificate programme), which hold the official list of centres, returned HTTP 429 (too many requests) on every attempt, so the list of certificate centres could not be read. Only Makerere's certificate is verified; other certificate centres exist (one source mentions Bahcesehir University in Istanbul) but are not recorded because no page that was read names their programme.

The Duke page says 'master's degree programs in the social sciences' at UNC with examples; global studies, education, political science, journalism, city and regional planning and public health come from it. Social Work comes from the centre's own site, read in the first pass.
ICU lists several other master's programmes in the same Graduate School; only the Peace Studies master's is recorded because the pages say Rotary fellows study Peace Studies.
